summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO spanning the Lantern March and its streamed frontier regions. MMORPG Tools owns character, realm and UI lifecycle; ordered player behaviors compose movement, class kits, quests, trade, flight, vitality and per-player regional music, while place bindings and YAML registries define content. Realms are separate rooms with per-realm character rosters backed by shared SQL persistence.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - realm selection and front door for entering the world or opening character creation.
places/character-creation-land/ - race/class/appearance selection with preview character and creation camera.
places/main/config.yaml - Lantern March continent terrain, regional surfaces/scatter, roads and atmosphere.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach hub, residents, services, quests, chapter sites and town-square ambience.
places/main/cells/x1z0.scene - eastern Copperlane extension and armsmith display; spatial bird/hammer and woods ambience are placed here.
places/main/cells/x2z13.scene + x3z13.scene - Saltmere fishing jetty and beach hamlet at about x328,z1665: dock, pier, lit gear, surf audio and bobbing rowboat.
places/main/cells/ - 98 streamed continent cells covering Briarwild, northern March, Emberstone, Saltmere, Sorrowfen, Tideglass and frontier landmarks/campaigns.
places/hollowcrypt/ - underground dungeon entered from the mausoleum in main; cells hold crypt halls, archive, Warden, Vale/Elric, candles and echoes.
roots: world.config.yaml - main-menu-land default entry; binds player/camera templates, MMORPG UI, arrival redirect, routing and realm pulse.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/mod.json - registers MMORPG lifecycle, cameras, character/interaction behaviors and UI actions.
templates/player.js#player - ordered locomotion, movement, class, quest, vendor, flight, vitality, cursor-free and region-music behaviors.
templates/camera.js#camera - gameplay camera template; MMORPG has separate creation and menu camera paths.
places/main/config.yaml - owns continent terrain and regional surface/scatter configuration; cells supply local structures and interactions.
places/hollowcrypt/config.yaml - owns dungeon gravity, dark atmosphere and lighting; cells bind crypt geometry and encounters.
mods/gavi/mod.json - registers Gavi crew behavior and panel, the builder-facing companion tools.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG registries, persistence, currency and UI modules reused by MMORPG behaviors, gameplay scripts and ui.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - character persistence, roster population, realm list and selected-realm detail shared by menu and player lifecycle.
scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - realm roster/config read by scripts/routing.js and crons/realm-pulse.js; room IDs must match realm-save metadata.
scripts/lib/data/quests.yml + MMORPG lib/quest-data.js - quest mechanics shared by quest-core, quest-giver and quest UI; dialogue prose is separate in quest-text.yml.
scripts/lib/quest-text.js - lazy shared quest-dialogue lookup for scripts/quest-core.js and MMORPG quest-giver.js; data lives in quest-text.yml.
scripts/lib/economy.js + MMORPG lib/currency.js - integer-copper transactions/ledger and denomination formatting shared by quests, vendor, flight and UI.
scripts/lib/regions.js + scripts/terrain-reach.js - regional classification and continent terrain; regions.js also supplies ids consumed by scripts/region-music.js.
scripts/lib/data/music.yml - per-place and per-region music themes, volume and fade settings consumed by scripts/region-music.js.
notableExports: scripts/arrival.js - onArrive, onLeave; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom; crons/realm-pulse.js - cron.
MMORPG main-menu-mgr.js - getMenuRoster, getSelectedRosterIndex, hydrateMenuRoster, update, onSpawn, onInput; character-select.js - preview lifecycle, update/input and spawn handlers.
MMORPG ui.js - UI composition/actions; lib/ui-quest.js - quest dialog/tracker renderers; lib/version.js - GAME_VERSION 0.31.0 Alpha, GAME_TITLE, versionTag.
MMORPG lib/realm-save.js - realm list/detail refresh, roster persistence and realm metadata; lib/ui-character-roster.js - renderCharacterRoster.
MMORPG lib/ui-hud.js - renderTargetDisplay, renderHUD; class-aware action bar presents kit/cooldowns in slots 1-3 unless saved spellBar entries override.
scripts/player.js - onInput/update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - gait; scripts/vitality.js - scheduled fall/rise, mending and PvP zone/death handling.

scripts/quest-player.js - ears.kill, onInput, update (lazy quest-core delegate); scripts/quest-core.js - onInput, update; scripts/lib/quest-text.js - qt, withText, warm; scripts/lib/realm-firsts.js - questFirst, levelFirst; scripts/db.js - database helpers.

scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js, pathfinder.js and shade.js - class combat handlers; scripts/lib/kit.js - class/combat helpers; scripts/cursor-free.js - pointer-lock handling; scripts/bob.js - updateSchedule, update; scripts/region-music.js - updateSchedule, update.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent and velocity/footstep state; place config owns gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient gait/turn state, character yaw and animation channels; gait samples prior-tick movement velocity.

MMORPG player.js and lib/realm-save.js - active character, roster snapshots and persisted character records, including discovered roosts and quest state; realm-save also patches realmList/realmDetail UI state.
main-menu-mgr.js - menu roster loading and selected roster slot; selection hydration prefers valid activeCharIdx, falling back to selectedCharIdx and clamping to roster bounds.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js, pathfinder.js and shade.js - class action/cooldown/combat state; Shade stores veiledUntil on player state and transient readiness/ambush windows in session.
scripts/quest-core.js - quest interactions, progression, dialogue, inventory/cache/mark state and _questSave; scripts/quest-player.js ears.kill increments tally/XP and raises _questSave.
scripts/lib/realm-firsts.js - claims one realm/feat first in SQL; a winning claim writes room-wide world.state.herald; scripts/lib/quest-text.js owns the asynchronously imported dialogue book cache.
scripts/region-music.js - per-player ctx.session _areaTheme/_areaAt deduplication state; player state musicMuted, musicVolume and activeTrack govern whether/how area themes play.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → main-menu-mgr/main-menu UI → realm roster or character selection → creation/enter-world → main gameplay lifecycle.

Arrival outside main-menu-land without fresh _worldEnterAt or creation-place _creationEnterAt → scripts/arrival.js redirects to menu; menu Enter/Create and scripts/crypt-gate.js stamp transition exceptions.
main-menu-mgr loads current-room SQL roster and population; api.enterPlace routes selected character to saved place/position; routing validates requested room, then last room, then main.

scripts/lib/data/realms.yml → scripts/routing.js and crons/realm-pulse.js; room cron writes player count to realm_pulse with SQLite time, and realm-save.js reads pulses (older than 180 s is quiet/zero).

realm-save refreshRealmList → player.state.realmList: pulse/character counts and global hero counts drive population, awake and least-populated-Normal recommendation; realmDetail queries top heroes and recent realm_firsts.
main-menu-mgr realm-list actions → realm-save refreshes selection detail; joinRealm refuses displayed Full realm, otherwise api.cross enters its room.
Character creation race/class → lib/races.js race start and character state → MMORPG player.js/realm-save upsert to characters keyed by user, realm and slot; each realm has an independent roster.
New character creation writes activeCharIdx and selectedCharIdx to the new slot; on menu roster hydration, main-menu-mgr resumes activeCharIdx when valid, otherwise selectedCharIdx.

templates/player.js order → locomotion → movement → class handlers including Shade → quest-player → vendor → flight → vitality → cursor-free → region-music; movement/camera intents are consumed by player.js/wow-move.js under place gravity.

First in-world quest-player update/input for a created hero in main or hollowcrypt → dynamic import scripts/quest-core.js; subsequent input/update delegate there, while ears.kill is handled immediately by the lightweight wrapper.
Interact/E → quest-core resolves NPCs, talkers, readable props, caches, timber and quest marks; quests.yml + quest-data define mechanics, quest-text.js supplies dialogue and ui-quest renders it.

scripts/region-music.js reads player place/feetPosition, lazy-loads scripts/lib/regions.js and looks up scripts/lib/data/music.yml → player-specific ctx.musicShift; musicMuted/activeTrack suppress area playback, and themes crossfade on region changes.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/ landmark builders reuse scripts/gen/shape.js procedural geometry helpers, varied by landmark and parameters; crypt.js supplies Hollowcrypt halls, rooms and furniture.
scripts/gen/fen.js - procedural marsh props reused by Sorrowfen cells, varied by kind/seed/LOD; boardwalk geometry and collider share length/width/elevation parameters.
scripts/gen/tide.js - Tideglass structures and props share shape helpers; kind/LOD/length/width vary each piece.
scripts/gen/unseen.js - Old Bond House, yard wall, mirrors, case, dead drops and quest props share procedural geometry/material helpers, varied by params.kind and LOD.
scripts/gen/grove.js - Deepgrove gate, spiral tree, shrine, archive, roots, blight and props share shape emitters; params.kind/seed and LOD vary pieces.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js, mushroom.js and pebble.js - terrain scatter geometry reused by place bindings, varied by layer density, scale, seed or per-item params.
scripts/gen/tree.js with scripts/tree-look.js - painted bark/alpha-cut foliage recur in forest layers and placed scatters, varied by tree kind and LOD.
scripts/scavengers.js - one manager handles configured camps and scavenger rows; scripts/lib/data/scavengers.yml sets camp stats/crew, including Q006 aggro 7 m, 70 HP and 38 damage.
migrationNotes: Money is one integer copper amount; 100 copper = 1 silver and 100 silver = 1 gold. Route transactions through scripts/lib/economy.js to preserve purse floor, ledger and UI feedback.

templates/player.js behavior order is significant: locomotion before movement, then class handlers including Shade, quests, vendor, flight, vitality, cursor-free and region-music; gait samples prior-tick velocity.
Movement intent/locomotion scratch is room-local ctx.session; scripts/player.js writes velocity while place config owns gravity.

state.xp remains cumulative while xpInto/xpToLevel are current-bar values; levels.yml owns total-XP anchors and progression cap 60, and class damage derives from configured damagePerLevel through lib/kit.js power.

Monster managers target kill and coins events to the hero's own behaviors: quest-player ears.kill owns tally/XP persistence, vendor owns coin ledger/purse; do not mutate the remote hero save from the monster's machine.

Quest mechanics and YAML imports live in scripts/quest-core.js, dynamically loaded by quest-player only for created heroes in main/hollowcrypt; keep quest-player ears.kill table-free for early targeted kill events. Area themes use the player's mute/volume/activeTrack and call musicShift with a player audience; retain the jukebox override and per-player isolation.
